summary: Two regional training coordinators left and their replacements have not assigned the required courses. Several building teams paused training after reporting repeated login failures. The operations director wants a recovery plan before the November renewal.

The customer is testing a competing training platform at three apartment buildings. Supervisors stopped assigning new courses during the trial. The team also complained that resident-service lessons repeat material staff already know.

The customer replaced a large group of onsite staff after a management transition. Their new training administrator has not completed user onboarding. The account currently has no assigned success manager and needs a save call.

The customer said a planned contractor rotation could reduce course participation after summer. The operations lead also asked about FixTrail Maintenance Academy for newly acquired buildings. These plans were discussed before the current reporting period.

The customer acquired four apartment buildings and expects to hire more supervisors. The regional director asked about CrewHarbor Manager Track which is not in their current subscription. Existing teams continue to use the platform most days.

The customer added two apartment buildings to its management portfolio. The maintenance lead requested a demonstration of FixTrail Maintenance Academy which the account does not own. They want to train the incoming technicians before year end.
